note: Self-written manuals (restoring a backup), each in a clean version and a planted one. Each mistake names its kind, the line it is on, the text the clean line has there (clean) and the planted line has instead (planted), and the rule expected to report it on that line. A rule that does not exist yet is named as the rule that should. Two plants change a second line as well: step-order swaps the numbers of steps 3 and 4 (line 13 too), and prerequisite-after-step moves the instruction to stop the order service from Before you start (line 7) to the end. yarn planted manual scores them; expected.json is the committed score.
